text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. Daiichi Ruby 
struggles to conquer her 
mid-to-long-distance hurdle. Out of 
nowhere, Mejiro Ramonu joins the camp on a 
whim and looks for a partner to train 
alongside.

Daiichi Ruby volunteers as a training 
partner. To determine the path she should 
take, she takes a gamble by challenging a 
2,400m race, but suffers a defeat...

Just then, her Trainer proposed a rematch. 
They told Daiichi Ruby that her tremendous 
closing burst was the very "brilliance" 
she possessed.

Daiichi Ruby challenges the 1,600m once 
more only to suffer a narrow defeat. Yet, 
Mejiro Ramonu acknowledges a brilliant 
spark in her late charge.

Believing the royal road was the only way 
to fulfill her duty, she had a change of 
heart. Resolved to show her brilliance on 
the path suited for her, she decides to 
switch to sprinting.
